label: Diagram 2.2
caption: Diagram 2.2 Alternative arrangements for final exits
description:
This drawing is a plan diagram titled "Diagram 2.2 Alternative arrangements for final exits", the title being set in a green band along the bottom of the drawing, with "See para 2.5" at the top left. It has two parts, a. and b., each a rectangular floor plan with internal walls and a green line that forms the protected route of travel.

In part a., the green line runs horizontally across the plan and also drops in a vertical branch down to the bottom wall; three "Fd" symbols mark doorways, one on the vertical branch and two on the horizontal line. A label "Protected stairway" sits above a stair symbol with a directional arrow at the lower centre. A green arrow projects from the right wall, labelled "Final exit".

In part b., the green line runs from the left wall, where an "Fd" symbol marks a doorway, to a stair to the left of centre, which is itself enclosed by green and labelled "Protected stairway" with a directional arrow. Two further "Fd" symbols mark the stair doors on its right-hand side. Two green arrows project from the right wall, each labelled "Final exit".

A key on the right defines the green line as "Fire resisting construction minimum REI 30" and "Fd" as "Fire doorset minimum E 20".
